name: Shallum
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him and smote him before the people. That is a public assassination, a public execution, and then he reigned in his stead.
Shallum conspires against Zachariah, smites him before the people, slays him, and reigns in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: Shallum reigned a full month in Samaria, thirty days. Judah was on point at this time; the northern kingdom were going off.
Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, smote Shallum and reigned in his stead. Being king did not guarantee your life; your life was marked.
Shallum reigns a full month in Samaria before Menahem son of Gadi goes up from Tirzah, smites him, and reigns in his stead.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House
